Problem: Round $6287215$ to the nearest ten thousand.

The ten thousands place is the 5th digit from the right. To round to the nearest ten thousand, look at the thousands place (4th digit from the right). If the thousands digit is 5 or more, round up; otherwise round down. The number being rounded is 6287215.
This mislabels the place values. The last two digits '15' are the tens and ones digits, not the thousands place; the thousands digit of 6287215 is 7 (the 4th digit from the right).
List the digits from right to left with correct place values (ones, tens, hundreds, thousands, etc.) and identify the thousands digit as 7.
